P. Within an hour, he was in jail.
Q. He made no attempts to hide his identity and even looked directly into the security camera and smiled.
R. On Jan 6, 1995, McArthur Wheeler boldly robbed two banks in broad daylight with no disguise.
S. By 11:00 at night, his picture was all over the news, leading an informant to identify Wheeler to the police.
options: PRQS
SPQR
RQSP
RPSQ
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "RQSP"

Explanation:
☛ Sentence R introduces the 'main event' (McArthur Wheeler robbing banks) and sets the 'timeline' (Jan 6, 1995), making it the logical 'opening sentence'.
☛ Sentence Q follows R as it details how Wheeler 'made no attempts to hide' and 'smiled at the camera', extending the action.
☛ Sentence S comes next because the camera footage led to his picture being broadcast, triggering the informant's call (cause-effect).
☛ Sentence P concludes the paragraph by showing the 'final outcome' (jail), which is the result of the police action in S.

Rearrangement Strategy:
☛ Identify the 'introductory sentence' (R) that sets context and time.
☛ Track 'pronoun references' (he in Q) and 'action sequence' (rob → smile → news → arrest).
☛ Follow 'time indicators' (within an hour, by 11:00) chronologically.
☛ Re-read to ensure 'cause-effect' and 'logical flow' are intact.

Full Sentence: On Jan 6, 1995, McArthur Wheeler boldly robbed two banks in broad daylight with no disguise. He made no attempts to hide his identity and even looked directly into the security camera and smiled. By 11:00 at night, his picture was all over the news, leading an informant to identify Wheeler to the police. Within an hour, he was in jail.
